sources_note_en: Each story lists its source and date. Company announcements are attributed and availability follows the documented scope.

thesis_en: As product data moves into AI answers, check sources, specifications and approvals
thesis_note: 由DeepSeek搜尋到ChatGPT商品型錄，把顧客會問的資料逐項核對，再決定對外開放範圍。
thesis_note_en: From DeepSeek search to ChatGPT product feeds, check the details shoppers ask about before deciding what to publish.

items.title: DeepSeek向API開放搜尋、檔案和讀取連結功能
items.summary: DeepSeek公布，開發者可在V4.1-Flash的支援端點使用應用程式原有的搜尋、檔案及讀取連結功能。
highlights: 搜尋可回傳來源，檔案功能支援PDF及其他指定格式。
延伸工具按用量另外收費。
items.why: 品牌團隊可把公開產品資料接入問答流程，並評估來源可追溯性和每次查詢成本。
items.next_step: 用公開型錄和產品頁試做一組問題，逐題核對引用、回答和工具費用。
items.detail: DeepSeek表示，開發者可從支援端點啟用網頁搜尋、檔案輸入及連結讀取，讓模型以外部資料回答。搜尋等延伸工具用量費在模型用量之外計算。品牌試做產品問答時，可先採用一小批已公開資料，核對引述的內容是否符合原頁，以及每條問題觸發多少工具操作。
items.title_en: DeepSeek brings search, files and link reading to its API
items.summary_en: DeepSeek says developers can use search, file input and link reading from its app through supported V4.1-Flash endpoints.
highlights_en: Search can return citations, and file input supports PDFs and other specified formats.
Extended tools incur separate usage fees.
items.why_en: Brand teams can test public product information in a Q&A workflow and assess citations and costs per query.
items.next_step_en: Use a public catalogue and product pages to compare answers, citations and tool costs.
items.detail_en: DeepSeek says developers can enable web search, file input and link reading on supported endpoints so the model can answer with external material. Extended tools incur usage fees in addition to model fees. For product Q&A, start with a small public dataset and check cited material against the original pages and how many tool calls each question triggers.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: 更進新聞：Brandlight推出ChatGPT商品型錄匯出與代理指示工具
items.summary: Brandlight公布兩項配置工具，協助企業準備ChatGPT品牌代理指示及商品資料。
highlights: 可從現有Brandlight Commerce型錄匯出ChatGPT商品資料格式。
指示由Brandlight資料輔助生成，企業仍需確認OpenAI的商家及代理資格。
items.why: 電商和客服團隊可把商品資料的準確性與品牌代理回答規則分開驗收。
items.next_step: 抽查一批商品的庫存和售價，再讓客服主管審閱退貨和轉介指示。
items.detail: Brandlight表示，新工具可根據其平台資料生成ChatGPT品牌代理指示，並把客戶現有Brandlight Commerce型錄轉為ChatGPT商品資料格式。企業可先按地區確認商家和代理開放資格，再核對匯出欄位及客服回答規則。Brandlight指出，認領商家頁面也無法保證得到更多獨立推薦。
items.title_en: Update: Brandlight adds ChatGPT catalogue export and agent instruction tools
items.summary_en: Brandlight announced tools to prepare instructions for ChatGPT Business Agents and format product data.
highlights_en: Existing Brandlight Commerce catalogues can be exported in ChatGPT's product feed format.
Instructions draw on Brandlight data. Companies still need to check OpenAI's eligibility rules.
items.why_en: Commerce and service teams can validate product data and the agent's response rules separately.
items.next_step_en: Check a sample of product stock and prices, then have support leads review return and escalation instructions.
items.detail_en: Brandlight says the tools draft ChatGPT Business Agent instructions from its platform data and convert existing Brandlight Commerce catalogues into ChatGPT's feed format. Confirm market and agent eligibility before validating feed fields and support responses. Brandlight says claiming a profile does not guarantee higher visibility in independent recommendations.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.followup: 11月13日版報道OpenAI商家中心。本次是第三方Brandlight新增型錄及指示工具。
items.followup_en: The November 13 edition covered OpenAI's Business Hub. This update covers Brandlight's third-party preparation tools.

items.title: 更進新聞：京東披露雙11眼鏡虛擬試戴及美妝虛擬主播直播
items.summary: 京東稱，今年雙11把虛擬試用擴至眼鏡，並升級App內的東東購物助手。
highlights: 東東可協助比較價格、查詢優惠及尋找售後服務。
京東列出蘭蔻中國電商負責人的虛擬主播主持促銷直播的案例。
items.why: 零售團隊可按品類選工具，分別檢查試戴、問答和直播能否回答顧客的問題。
items.next_step: 先用一組眼鏡或美妝商品測試，記錄產品資料錯誤、未解問題及需要轉接人員的環節。
items.detail: 京東在雙11回顧中列出三種顧客接觸方式，包括為眼鏡加入虛擬試戴、在購物App升級東東助手，以及讓代表蘭蔻中國電商負責人的虛擬主播主持一節促銷直播。品牌可分開評估試戴、購物問答和直播的用途，並核對商品規格、優惠及售後資訊能否在各入口保持一致。該回顧聚焦京東平台內的做法。
items.title_en: Update: JD.com details eyewear try-ons and a beauty avatar livestream
items.summary_en: JD.com says it extended virtual try-ons to eyewear during Singles' Day and upgraded Dongdong, its in-app shopping assistant.
highlights_en: Dongdong helps compare prices, navigate promotions and find after-sales service.
JD.com describes a promotional livestream hosted by an avatar representing Lancôme China's ecommerce president.
items.why_en: Retailers can choose tools by category and check whether try-ons, Q&A and livestreams answer shoppers' questions.
items.next_step_en: Test one eyewear or beauty assortment and log incorrect product information, unanswered questions and requests for staff.
items.detail_en: JD.com's Singles' Day recap described virtual eyewear try-ons, the updated Dongdong assistant and a promotional livestream hosted by an avatar representing Lancôme China's ecommerce president. Brands can review the purpose of each format and check whether product specs, offers and after-sales details stay consistent across entry points. The recap covers practices on JD.com's platform.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.followup: 11月13日版報道雙11大市估算。京東回顧早於該期公布，今次補充平台的試戴、購物問答及直播案例。
items.followup_en: The November 13 edition covered the market estimate. JD.com's earlier recap adds platform examples of try-ons, shopping Q&A and livestreaming.

items.title: YouArt推出桌面影片代理，把客戶意見連到指定鏡頭
items.summary: YouArt公布Mac及PC桌面工具，可讀取本機專案資料，並把客戶意見放到相關畫面。
highlights: 創作人可審閱修訂並決定保留哪些版本。
經使用者授權，代理可操作After Effects及Premiere等指定工具。
items.why: 製作團隊可減少在回饋訊息和專案時間軸之間來回查找，並保留審稿責任。
items.next_step: 用複製專案測試一項客戶修訂，記錄檔案權限、改動位置及回復版本所需的步驟。
items.detail: YouArt表示，桌面代理可把Slack或Gmail來的意見連到相關鏡頭、畫格或創意元素。獲使用者授權後，可在指定剪輯工具中執行部分操作，創作人仍可檢查並決定保留哪些修改。團隊試用時可先選擇容易回復的修改，並把原始專案、修訂檔和審稿紀錄分開保存。
items.title_en: YouArt launches desktop video agent that attaches feedback to shots
items.summary_en: YouArt announced a Mac and PC tool that can work with local project files and attach client feedback to relevant shots.
highlights_en: Creators review revisions and decide which changes to keep.
With permission, the agent can operate supported applications such as After Effects and Premiere Pro.
items.why_en: Production teams can link feedback to timelines while keeping creative reviews with people.
items.next_step_en: Test one revision on a copy, tracking file permissions, edits and how to restore the previous version.
items.detail_en: YouArt says its desktop agent can attach feedback from Slack or Gmail to a shot, frame or creative element. With user permission it can perform tasks in supported editing applications. Creators review and choose what to keep. Start with a reversible change and keep the original project, revised file and approval record separately.

items.title: MCM香港把Monchhichi聯乘延伸至海港城活動
items.summary: MAD Thailand報道，MCM安排泰國藝人Freen Sarocha出席香港海港城的Monchhichi聯乘活動。
highlights: 聯乘把日本Monchhichi角色帶到MCM四款經典袋型。
POPBEE報道，香港和澳門先接受專門店WhatsApp預訂，再公開發售。
items.why: 區內零售團隊可把聯乘商品的預訂、公開發售和門店活動設為不同接觸點。
items.next_step: 分開記錄訊息預訂、發售後到店及活動登記，對照各環節的參與情況。
items.detail: MCM以Monchhichi角色改造四款經典袋型。POPBEE報道，香港和澳門先以專門店WhatsApp接受預訂，再公開發售。MAD Thailand另報道，品牌安排Freen Sarocha到海港城參與聯乘活動。零售團隊可參考這種安排，按預訂和門店活動分開記錄參與情況。
items.title_en: MCM extends its Monchhichi collaboration to a Hong Kong Harbour City event
items.summary_en: MAD Thailand reported that MCM scheduled Thai artist Freen Sarocha to appear at its Harbour City Monchhichi collaboration event.
highlights_en: The collection puts the Japanese Monchhichi character on four MCM signature bag styles.
POPBEE reported that Hong Kong and Macau store WhatsApp reservations preceded public sales.
items.why_en: Regional retailers can treat reservations, public sales and store events as distinct customer touchpoints.
items.next_step_en: Measure message reservations, post-launch visits and event registrations separately.
items.detail_en: MCM put the Monchhichi character on four signature bag styles. POPBEE reported WhatsApp reservations through stores in Hong Kong and Macau ahead of public sales. MAD Thailand separately reported a scheduled Harbour City appearance by Freen Sarocha. Retail teams can track reservation and event participation separately when evaluating a similar rollout.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Motom公布Opportunities，把創作者活動接到品牌自營店面
items.summary: Motom公布創作者活動模組，讓品牌在自有計劃管理付費及送贈品合作。
highlights: 可參考創作者內容、過往銷售及計劃參與度選人。
公司指首階段計劃面向現有客戶。
items.why: 零售商可把創作者合作的邀約、到店及成交數據串起來，並分開檢視付費與自然銷售。
items.next_step: 為同一商品設定清楚的創作者連結與歸因窗口，比對自營店面記錄和訂單。
items.detail: Motom表示，品牌和零售商可在管理平台向創作者提出合作，並將活動流量帶到其網站上的創作者店面。模組涵蓋付費與贈品合作，可比較相關付費及自然銷售。公告列出先向現有客戶開放的安排。試行時可統一訂單歸因及退款口徑，再比較不同創作者。報表亦可按合作類型分開檢視。
items.title_en: Motom announces Opportunities to link creator campaigns with owned storefronts
items.summary_en: Motom announced a module that lets brands manage paid and gifting collaborations inside their own creator programmes.
highlights_en: Teams can select creators using content, sales history and programme activity.
The company plans to open initial access to existing customers.
items.why_en: Retailers can connect outreach, storefront visits and orders while tracking paid and organic sales separately.
items.next_step_en: Assign creator links and attribution windows for one product, then reconcile storefront records with orders.
items.detail_en: Motom says brands and retailers can offer collaborations in the admin portal and send campaign traffic to creator storefronts on their own sites. The module covers paid and gifting campaigns and supports comparing paid and organic sales. Existing clients are listed for initial access. Align attribution and refunds before comparing creators. Reports can also be reviewed by collaboration type.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Constant Contact公布Catalyst，小企可審批AI擬定的活動
items.summary: Constant Contact公布面向小企的Catalyst，工具可按企業的線上內容擬定計劃，並交由負責人審稿。
highlights: 公司列出電郵、社交平台及短訊等支援方向。
現階段可登記早期使用計劃。
items.why: 小企可先檢查AI是否能維持跨渠道語氣，再決定哪些執行步驟適合交給工具。
items.next_step: 挑一個促銷主題，逐項核對電郵和社交文案的日期、優惠及發送對象。
items.detail: 按Constant Contact公告，Catalyst會參考企業的線上內容，草擬分項計劃及跨渠道文案。企業負責人審批內容後，工具才執行相關工作。現階段提供早期使用計劃；安排試點時，可先為活動設定一名批准人，並逐一核對優惠條件、品牌語氣及發送名單。
items.title_en: Constant Contact announces Catalyst with small-business approval for AI campaigns
items.summary_en: Constant Contact announced Catalyst for small businesses. It can draft a plan from a business's online presence and send content for review.
highlights_en: The company describes channels including email, social and SMS.
Businesses can register for early access.
items.why_en: Small teams can check tone across channels before deciding which execution steps to delegate.
items.next_step_en: Choose one promotion and check the dates, offer and audience in draft email and social copy.
items.detail_en: Constant Contact says Catalyst reviews a business's online presence and drafts a plan and copy across channels. A person approves content before the tool executes related work. Access is through an early programme. For a pilot, assign an approver and check offer terms, brand tone and the recipient list.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Spangle將商品資料工具獨立開放予企業品牌
items.summary: Spangle宣布Product Intelligence 360可獨立接入，讓企業品牌把商品資料用於自有電商及AI工具。
highlights: 可經API或商品資料接入。
商品記錄可結合商品屬性、銷售情況及顧客查詢，由品牌審批上線。
items.why: 商品管理團隊可先把規格和顧客選購用語對齊，再決定哪些內容適合對外發放。
items.next_step: 挑一個品類，抽查商品屬性、常見問題和人工批准紀錄，再測試匯出。
items.detail: Spangle表示，Product Intelligence 360以個別商品為單位，整理規格、成交情況及顧客查詢等資料。公司公布企業品牌可以透過API或商品資料獨立接入，品牌團隊仍負責審批上線內容。測試時可先集中在單一品類，確認資料可追溯到原有來源，也可按需要回復。
items.title_en: Spangle makes its product intelligence tool available separately to enterprise brands
items.summary_en: Spangle announced standalone access to Product Intelligence 360 for enterprise brands to use product data in commerce and AI tools.
highlights_en: Teams can connect through APIs or product feeds.
Product records can combine attributes, sales and shopper queries, subject to brand approval before publishing.
items.why_en: Merchandising teams can align specs with shopper language before releasing product information.
items.next_step_en: Pick one category and check attributes, common questions and the human approval record before export.
items.detail_en: Spangle says Product Intelligence 360 organizes specifications, sales and shopper questions at product level. Enterprise brands can connect it independently through APIs or product feeds, while brand teams approve public changes. Start with one category and check that each item can be traced back to its original source and reverted when needed.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Fiserv為美國Clover商戶加入AI建站與庫存同步
items.summary: Fiserv公布，美國Clover商戶可從基本商戶資料建立網店，並連接現有門店商品和庫存。
highlights: 公司列出搜尋及AI購物曝光設定。
商品、庫存、顧客、訂單和付款可與Clover同步。
items.why: 有門市的小企可先檢查網店與門店是否讀取同一份庫存，避免促銷期間顯示已售罄商品。
items.next_step: 挑幾款暢銷商品，核對庫存更新、訂單狀態及搜尋可見的商品資料。
items.detail: Fiserv稱，Clover的美國商戶可輸入基本資料及創意偏好來建立網店。新功能包括搜尋及AI購物曝光設定，亦可把商品、庫存和訂單與門店Clover系統同步。零售團隊可先測試購買後的庫存更新，並核對搜尋頁看到的商品資料是否與網店一致。亦可核對退款後的庫存變動。
items.title_en: Fiserv adds AI site creation and inventory sync for US Clover merchants
items.summary_en: Fiserv says US Clover merchants can create a store using basic business details and connect their existing products and inventory.
highlights_en: The company describes discovery settings for search and AI shopping.
Products, stock, customers, orders and payments can sync with Clover.
items.why_en: Store operators can check whether online and in-store stock come from the same source to avoid promoting sold-out items.
items.next_step_en: Check stock updates, order status and search-visible product data for a few popular items.
items.detail_en: Fiserv says US Clover merchants can create an online store using basic details and creative preferences. New capabilities include discovery settings for search and AI shopping and sync products, inventory and orders with Clover. Test inventory changes after a purchase and check that the information shown in search matches the store. Check stock changes after a refund as well.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: FocusFuel公布ZAYN合作，以巡演幕後概念設計聯乘套裝
items.summary: FocusFuel公布歌手ZAYN為投資者及合作夥伴，首個聯乘以巡演幕後為概念推出特別套裝。
highlights: 套裝包含士多啤梨檸檬及西瓜兩款口味。
品牌計劃加入幕後內容及紐約粉絲體驗。
items.why: 品牌可把藝人合作的故事轉為包裝和體驗設計，為不同接觸點設定可量度目標。
items.next_step: 為聯乘套裝、幕後內容和現場活動分別設定連結及追蹤指標。
items.detail: FocusFuel表示，與ZAYN的首個聯乘把巡演幕後靈感用於特別套裝，並安排幕後內容及紐約粉絲體驗。活動報道聚焦合作身分、套裝概念及推廣安排。品牌可參考這種做法，先定出粉絲從哪個渠道認識聯乘，再檢查內容互動、商品頁到訪及活動登記等不同環節。
items.title_en: FocusFuel announces ZAYN partnership with a backstage-inspired kit
items.summary_en: FocusFuel announced singer ZAYN as an investor and partner. Their first collaboration draws on backstage touring for a special kit.
highlights_en: The kit includes strawberry lemonade and watermelon flavours.
The brand plans behind-the-scenes content and a New York fan experience.
items.why_en: Brands can translate a partner story into packaging and experiences with measurable goals for each touchpoint.
items.next_step_en: Set distinct links and tracking measures for the kit, backstage content and live experience.
items.detail_en: FocusFuel says its first collaboration with ZAYN carries a touring backstage theme into a special kit. It also announced behind-the-scenes content and a planned New York fan experience. The case centers on the partnership, packaging and promotion. Teams can map where fans first encounter a collaboration and check content engagement, product-page visits and event registrations separately.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
